# Psalm 17 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A prayer of David. LORD, hear my plea for justice. Listen to my cry for help. Pay attention to my prayer, for it comes from honest lips.

**2** Declare me innocent, for You see what is right.

**3** You have tested my heart; You have examined me through the night. You have refined me and found nothing wrong. I am determined not to sin in what I say.

**4** I have followed Your commands, which have kept me from going along with cruel and violent people.

**5** My steps have stayed on Your path; I have not wavered.

**6** I am praying to You because I know You will answer, O God. Bend down and listen to me.

**7** Show me Your unfailing love in wonderful ways. By Your mighty power, rescue those who seek refuge in You from their enemies.

**8** Guard me as You would the pupil of Your eye. Hide me in the shadow of Your wings.

**9** Protect me from wicked people who attack me, from murderous enemies closing in on me.

**10** They have no compassion; their mouths overflow with arrogance.

**11** They track me down and surround me, watching for the chance to throw me to the ground.

**12** They are like hungry lions, eager to tear me apart — like young lions hiding in ambush.

**13** Arise, LORD! Stand against them and bring them down! Rescue me from the wicked with Your sword!

**14** By the power of Your hand, LORD, save me from those whose only reward is in this life. You satisfy them with treasures from Your storehouse; their children have plenty, and they store up wealth for their grandchildren.

**15** Because I am righteous, I will see You. When I awake, I will see You face to face and be satisfied.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **17:8**: Two of the Psalter's most intimate images combined: the pupil of God's eye (precious, protected) and the shadow of His wings (sheltered, warm).

— PNEUMA
